A '''desert wolf''' is a type of [[wolf]] that is located in the [[Kharidian Desert]]. Players who wish to kill desert wolves should bring [[waterskin]]s or wear an [[enchanted water tiara]] to avoid damage from thirst and possibly [[death (mechanic)|death]]. The desert wolf is relatively easy to defeat, being a low level monster.

It is quite abundant in the Kharidian Desert, so if players do not wish to fight it, just run away. Better yet, use the [[magic carpet]] service to get away from monsters. They are aggressive to players level 55 and below. Anyone under its level should be extremely careful and make sure they have plenty of water skins and food.
